mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName FROM PRODUCT_CATEGORIES ORDER BY CATEGORY_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_CATEGORIES WHERE UPPER(TRIM(CATEGORY_NAME)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{categoryName}))

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, COUNT(DISTINCT OI.ORDER_ID) AS orderCount, NVL(SUM(OI.QUANTITY), 0) AS totalOrderQuantity, NVL(SUM(OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE), 0) AS totalOrderPrice FROM PRODUCTS P, ORDER_ITEMS OI WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID(+) AND P.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_NAME

SELECT PC.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, PC.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY') AS year, TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'MM') AS month, NVL(SUM(OI.QUANTITY), 0) AS quantity FROM PRODUCT_CATEGORIES PC, PRODUCTS P, ORDER_ITEMS OI, ORDERS O WHERE PC.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID AND P.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID(+) AND OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID(+)
AND PC.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}
AND UPPER(REPLACE(TRIM(P.PRODUCT_NAME), ' ', '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(REPLACE(TRIM(#{productName}), ' ', '')) || '%'
AND O.ORDER_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, 'YYYYMMDD')
AND O.ORDER_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{toDate}, 'YYYYMMDD')
GROUP BY PC.CATEGORY_ID, PC.CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRODUCT_NAME, TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY'), TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'MM') ORDER BY PC.CATEGORY_NAME, P.PRODUCT_NAME, TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY'), TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'MM')
